notes:
**CHR-1103 — structured variant editor and step drag and drop in the use-case edit dialog** (follow-up to CHR-1062, epic CHR-1060). The full use-case spec stays in the `chr-1062` tag note; this tag marks what changed. Data contract: use-case spec §4 (variants, ops, `actors` map from CHR-1102) and §6 (validation).

## 1. Structured variant editor (replaces "Other overrides (JSON)")
Each variant box keeps Title / ID / Description / Applies when and gains three sections below a hairline, in the order the resolver applies them:
- **Overrides** — Trigger, Goal, Outcome, Personas, Inputs, Outputs in a `110px | 1fr` grid. Inherited = `uc-inherited` ("From base" + base value + **Override**); overridden = the field's normal editor prefilled from the base + **Use base** (sends `null`). Inputs/outputs replace the base list wholesale, so an override starts as a copy of the base rows.
- **Actor swaps** — `uc-select` from → to rows (System + personas), "+ Actor swap"; writes the variant `actors` map: applied once, before the step changes, to inherited base steps only; not chained (hint says so).
- **Step changes** — ordered `uc-step-op` rows: op select (Replace / Insert after / Remove / Append) + the step it targets (the flow at that point, so later changes can target steps added earlier) + the full step editor (id, actor, action, target, data changes). Diff colours from `usecases-detail-variant`: Replace amber, Insert after / Append green, Remove dashed red with the struck base step.
- Empty: "None. Every inherited step keeps its base actor." / "None. This variant runs the N base steps as they are."
- Errors (block Save): duplicate step id from a change (`chrome-field error`), a change without its step, a step without an action, plus the existing title / condition / example rules. Warnings (never block): a change pointing at a step not in the flow (`uc-select warning`, "… This change is skipped; you can still save."), unknown persona in a swap.

## 2. Step reordering (replaces the up/down buttons)
A `uc-drag-handle` in front of every base step and every step-change row. Pointer: only the handle drags; the real row lifts (translate, scale 1.02, float shadow), its slot stays as a dashed box, `uc-drop-marker` shows the landing gap, the body auto-scrolls, one move on release (`moveBefore`), animated, no motion under reduced motion. Keyboard: grab-move-drop on the handle (Space/Enter pick up, ArrowUp/Down move, Space/Enter drop, Esc cancel), `aria-pressed`, visible key hint, polite live region "<action>, moved to step N of M.". Follows the modern-web-guidance `drag-and-drop` guide.

## Screens
- Changed: `usecases-edit-dialog` (handles, Steps hint), `usecases-edit-dialog-variant` (structured editor, filled variant incl. a removed step).
- New: `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-empty` (new variant, nothing overridden; title error), `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-invalid` (warning + error + outputs override), `usecases-edit-dialog-step-drag` (pointer drag in progress), `usecases-edit-dialog-step-keyboard` (keyboard move).

## Design system
New: `uc-drag-handle` (default / focus / grabbed), `uc-drop-marker`, `uc-inherited`, pattern `uc-step-op` (default=Replace / insert-after / append / remove). Changed: `uc-select` + `warning`, `chrome-field` + `error`. All form controls stay native (CHR-1097): every select is a native `<select>` with text options.

## Code changes (for the build ticket)
`src/preview/usecases-forms.js`: the variant JSON textarea and its "not a JSON object" error go; the variant draft is edited field by field (overrides, `actors`, `steps` ops). Step move up/down buttons go; drag-and-drop + keyboard reorder on a handle for base steps and step changes. Payload shape unchanged apart from the new `actors` key (needs the CHR-1102 build first).
